Name: Classic
Description: Generates a signed procedural noise landscape with optional recursive detail, absolute-value shaping, and squared-value shaping.

Sections.Name: Shape
Sections.Label: Shape
Sections.Description: Primary form, amplitude, and profile controls.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Label: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the final signed height produced by the noise field. Positive values preserve the normal shape; negative values invert it.
Params.Tooltip: Overall amplitude and sign of the generated terrain.

Params.Name: Scale
Params.Label: Scale
Params.Description: Scales the sampling coordinates before evaluating noise, changing the size of the terrain features.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values produce smaller, more frequent features; lower values produce broader features.

Params.Name: SquareValue
Params.Label: Square Value
Params.Description: Squares the sampled noise value after the optional absolute-value operation, changing the profile of hills and valleys.
Params.Tooltip: Enable to bias values toward zero and create a sharper value response.

Params.Name: AbsoluteValue
Params.Label: Absolute Value
Params.Description: Reflects negative noise values into the positive range before applying strength.
Params.Tooltip: Enable to remove negative valleys and keep both sides of the noise field above zero.

Sections.Name: Detail
Sections.Label: Detail
Sections.Description: Secondary detail, distortion, and deterministic variation.

Params.Name: Levels
Params.Label: Levels
Params.Description: Controls how many recursive coordinate-warping noise levels are applied before the final sample.
Params.Tooltip: More levels add complex detail and increase the generator's cost.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Label: Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic noise pattern used by the generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible terrain layout.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Label: Offset
Params.Description: Translates the three-dimensional noise sampling position without changing the terrain scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use the offset to move through the noise field or align this shape with another generator.
